title: Longitudinal static stability - Level 3 minimum time to double amplitude of aperiodic speed divergence: Level 3, Category A

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

source.extract_quote: In no event shall its time to double amplitude be less than 6 seconds

scale_basis: the magnitude of the lower bound

conditions.search: grid, optional one-step local refinement around the critical point

status_policy.rule: No status other than OK can improve a verdict (FC-702); a DIVERGENT point fails every Level; no usable point gives NOT_ASSESSABLE (FC-701)

notes: Levels 1 and 2: no aperiodic airspeed divergence, controls fixed and free; pitch force and position vs airspeed smooth with stable local gradients (trimmer/throttle fixed, 1g, constant altitude, over trim speed +/-15 percent or +/-50 kt EAS whichever is less). Alternatively satisfied via FCS even with zero gradients. Level 3 may be relaxed subject to procuring-activity approval but 'In no event shall its time to double amplitude be less than 6 seconds'. L1/L2 check is qualitative (sign of dFs/dV and d(delta_s)/dV: nose-down control for faster speed).
